title: Spicy Ethiopian Chicken Tibs
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian-inspired stir-fry dish made with marinated chicken, onions, and bell peppers. Serve with injera or rice for a delicious and filling meal.
instructions: Heat liver oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and bell pepper to skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add tibs spice mix, thyme, salt, and black pepper to skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked chicken back into skillet and stir to combine with onion and bell pepper mixture.
Serve hot over injera or rice.
